description: Delete a webhook endpoint and its delivery history. This cannot be undone: update_webhook with status inactive pauses it instead. Needs the owner or admin role, and a key with no scope limits or a person's sign-in. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

webhook_id.description: The webhook endpoint UUID: id on a list_webhooks result.

name: delete_webhook
